name: 3-F-BPAP
summary: 3-F-BPAP is a trifluorinated derivative of benzofuranylpropylaminopentane (BPAP) and is an antagonist of the monoaminergic activity enhancer (MAE) effects of the tryptamine-related BPAP.

pharmacology.text: 3-F-BPAP is a trifluorinated derivative of benzofuranylpropylaminopentane (BPAP) and is an antagonist of the monoaminergic activity enhancer (MAE) effects of the tryptamine-related BPAP. The effects of MAEs like BPAP and selegiline appear to be mediated by TAAR1 agonism, and hence 3-F-BPAP may be acting as a TAAR1 antagonist (or weak partial agonist).

uses.text: 3-F-BPAP was developed by József Knoll and colleagues and was first described in the scientific literature in 2002.
